```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Load required packages
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(rio)

# Import the cleaned NHANES dataset
cleaned_nhanes <- import(here("data", "cleaned_nhanes.csv"))
```

Row {data-height=650}
Distribution of Age by Gender in the Clean_NHANES Sample
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
ggplot(cleaned_nhanes, aes(x = age, fill = gender)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, color = "white", boundary = 0, alpha = 0.8, position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "#999999")) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Age by Gender",
    subtitle = "Each bin represents a 5-year interval",
    x = "Age (Years)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```


Row {data-height=350}
Percentage of Adults (21+ Years)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
pct_adults <- mean(cleaned_nhanes$age >= 21, na.rm = TRUE) * 100

gauge(
  value = round(pct_adults, 1), 
  min = 0, 
  max = 100, 
  symbol = "%", 
  sectors = gaugeSectors(
    success = c(70, 100), 
    warning = c(40, 69), 
    danger = c(0, 39)
  )
)
```

Elevated Blood Pressure Rate
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
cleaned_nhanes <- cleaned_nhanes %>%
  mutate(
    avg_sbp = rowMeans(select(., systolic_bp_1, systolic_bp_2, systolic_bp_3, systolic_bp_4), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

pct_high_sbp <- mean(cleaned_nhanes$avg_sbp > 120, na.rm = TRUE) * 100

valueBox(
  value = paste0(round(pct_high_sbp, 1), "%"),
  caption = "Average SBP > 120 mm Hg",
  icon = "fa-heartbeat",
  color = "primary"
)
```
